mechanism: 남편의 동료 집단 소비의 변화가 가처분소득·저축 유인·소비 여력 경로를 통해 가계 소비의 증가로 이어질 수 있다는 조건부 설명 초안이다.
conditions: 논문의 처치·결과 정의와 대상 기업의 변수 정의가 일치할 것
논문의 모집단·시기·제도 및 효과 발생 시차가 적용 대상과 부합할 것

원자료 R06405의 적용 맥락: This paper uses linked administrative tax and employer-employee data covering the Danish population from 1980–1996 to study household consumption network effects. The unit is the household (with both spouses employed), consumption constructed from after-tax income and annual asset changes (wealth-tax-era data), and peer groups defined by co-workers at the plant level. Identification exploits firm-level shocks and intransitive worker–spouse–coworker network structure (distance-3 peers), combined with panel first-differencing/fixed effects; results are validated with the Danish Expenditure Survey (1994–1996).
